steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the viewport navigation bar is visible
the user selects Pan on the navigation bar
Pan is active
the Pan control is highlighted
the status area prompts the user to pan the current view and indicates cancellation is available
the active part and solid remain visible
the user presses Escape
the status area returns to Ready
the active part and solid remain visible

elements.name: Cancel Pan by clicking the viewport

steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport without dragging
Pan ends and the status area displays Ready
the same part and solid remain visible in their previous view

a contextual menu offers Done, OK, Home View, Orbit, Zoom and Previous View
